children: Police probe alleged safety lapses after a carbon dioxide leak killed two contract workers at Talegaon plant

Schaeffler India Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer Harsha Gopal Kadam has been taken into police custody in connection with a fatal accident at the company’s Talegaon manufacturing facility in Pune that claimed the lives of two contract workers in June.

According to the company’s regulatory filing dated October 20, Kadam was taken into custody by the Talegaon MIDC Police Station on October 19 under the provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023. Investigators have widened the probe to include him in his capacity as the factory’s legally designated occupier.

The accident occurred on June 9 during the scheduled replacement of carbon dioxide (CO₂) cylinders used in the plant’s fire-suppression system. A sudden gas discharge killed two workers employed by service providers, while others were injured and required medical attention.

The investigation is examining alleged lapses in workplace safety, including inadequate ventilation, the absence of appropriate emergency arrangements and possible violations of prescribed procedures during the maintenance work. These allegations remain subject to investigation.

Police have also examined the roles of company personnel and contractors involved in the work. Subsequent reports said Kadam experienced health complications during a medical examination and was admitted to hospital, with further legal proceedings dependent on his medical condition.

Schaeffler India said the company, its officers and employees had cooperated with authorities and would continue to do so. It is assessing the developments with its legal advisers and said its senior management remains responsible for day-to-day administration, with business operations continuing as usual.
The incident has brought industrial safety compliance and accountability at manufacturing facilities into focus, particularly where maintenance activities are carried out by third-party contractors.
